items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: We became very close friends, Father Peter O'Brien and I.

ctx.x: I really don't know. I was under 16 because you know, because when I played with Duke Ellington's Washingtonians I was between 16 and 17. I just found a date I went to Pittsburgh... I have some stockings, my first stockings that I wore with Seymour and Jeanette; I'll show them to you later. I just washed them last night. Peter brought all these things out in a trunk and so I found the date. It was in about '25 or '26 when I was with Seymour and Jeanette.
You mean you washed them and they didn't fall apart?
